title: l2_payload.json: no reserved-dispatch vector after reserved_0x16 replacement
description: 3x codereview on b7z9.120 (edge observation, not a defect): the canonical vector set lost its only reserved-dispatch vector when reserved_0x16 was replaced by sos_alert_dispatch. Per-language exhaustive 256-octet loops pin reserved-byte behavior in all three stacks and unknown_unwrapped_0x01 covers unknown-with-body, so coverage is not lost — but a named reserved-dispatch vector (e.g. reserved_0x17) would keep the canonical set self-documenting. Optional; the C reserved probe already moved to 0x17.
